messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
Viscous friction force depends on angular velocity and damping coefficient C.
C represents the viscous drag parameter and appears in the physical pendulum as damping torque T.
T should be included when damping is non-negligible, such as motion in a fluid, not in the ideal undamped model.
